items.html: But now, when the Mochin are within the female, whose Yesod is short and perforated, it is necessary that the Yesod of Aba extend and come out outside the Yesod of the Nukva and beyond, and its illumination be revealed in complete revelation. And it is known that what is clothed in the Yesod of ZA is the aspect of the Atarah of the Yesod of Aba, which is the aspect of the Malchut of Aba. And there is no doubt that this illumination revealed from the Malchut of Aba is an exceedingly great illumination.
